extracted.name: Olive Tapenade
extracted.description: This olive tapenade recipe is an easy, delicious appetizer! We love to serve it with crackers or baguette. Find additional serving suggestions in the post above.
ingredient_lines: 1½ cups pitted olives (mix of kalamata and green olives)
⅓ cup fresh basil or parsley
instruction_lines: In a small food processor, combine the olives, sun-dried tomatoes, olive oil, capers, lemon juice, and garlic.
Pulse until combined but still chunky. Add the fresh herbs and pulse again.
